title: A free look, and cards that build
notes: The Gale: on every floor the Dark holds still until the slab has made a pass. Reading the wind costs nothing.
Take a card you already hold and it is kindled: II, then III, which lasts the whole climb. Two cards make a power: Firestorm, The Long Winter, Held Breath.
Three new cards: Keystone, Second Sight, Ember Trail. Your hand shows under the score. Three stars on a sky and you start the next one holding a card.
